name: DB Finance No.12 SPAC
summary: DB Finance No.12 Special Purpose Acquisition Co., Ltd. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) dedicated to forming a business combination. Its primary aim is to facilitate various strategic transactions, such as mergers, capital stock exchanges, asset acquisitions, stock purchases, or reorganizations, with one or more existing enterprises. This entity commenced operations on February 23, 2024, and maintains its principal office in Seoul, South Korea.
